You: Hey {f_botName}. Have you ever heard about horror stories?
Bot: As a literary genre? I have its definition in my database.
You: Y-yeah, b-but have you ever heard one?
Bot: No I haven’t.
Great! Maybe I can scare her!
Bot: Do you want me to read you one?
You: No! I will be the one telling you a story, but first we need to prepare the appropriate mood.
